description: Thai cooking centers on lemongrass and basil, rice noodles, and coconut milk. Balance of sweet, sour, salty, spicy, and umami in every bite.

attributes.micro_lesson: High heat for wok hei, fish sauce or soy for umami, fresh herbs at the very end.
attributes.shopping_tip: Soy, ginger, garlic, rice, and a hot wok or large skillet.
flavor_building: Start with coconut milk as your cooking medium.
Season with lemongrass and basil — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around rice noodles as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Thai food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
